basics.name: Sicheng Tian
basics.summary: M.Sc. student in Photonics at Abbe School of Photonics, University of Jena. Research interests: optical microscopy, computational imaging, and photonics.

work.company: Leibniz Institute of Photonic Technology (IPHT), Microscopy Dept.
work.position: Research Assistant - Live-Cell Imaging of F-Actin by Polarization Fluorescence Microscopy
work.summary: Supervised by Prof. Dr. Rainer Heintzmann and Dr. Daniela Taeuber. Conducting literature review and familiarising with the 2DPOLIM live-cell imaging platform.

work.company: Leibniz Institute of Photonic Technology (IPHT), Microscopy Dept.
work.position: Research Assistant - Mid-IR Spectroscopic Imaging of RPE Granules
work.summary: PiF-IR measurement and PCA-based analysis of RPE granules with team guidance. 5 nm/pixel describes sampling, not validated resolution.

work.company: Leibniz Institute of Photonic Technology (IPHT), Quantum Detection Dept.
work.position: Research Assistant - MAGIC NOR Logic Gate Based on BFO Memristors
work.summary: Research training in BiFeO3 memristor measurements, MAGIC NOR logic experiments, endurance and retention testing.

work.position: Bachelor Thesis - Deep Learning for Alzheimer's Disease Classification
work.summary: Supervised by Prof. Haimin Luo. Incorporated CSF biomarker data into a multimodal neural network; MLP-based fusion achieved improvements in accuracy and sensitivity over the baseline model.
